svg.title: Prospective DE-LU forecast track record
svg.desc: Source-derived prospective record from 3 August 2026 to 17 October 2026, with 68 scored delivery days and 1632 scored hours. The sample is still accumulating.
svg.text: Sealed before auction close · scored after settlement
